:= by
  constructor
  intro M f
  let P := R.cochainComplex
  let ι : P ⟶ P.underlyingModule (R.underlyingModule M) :=
    P.underlyingModule.map (R.underlyingModule.map f)
  let h : ι ≫ P.underlyingModule.map (R.underlyingModule.map f) = 0 :=
    P.underlyingModule.map (R.underlyingModule.map f).comp_right_zero
  let φ : P ⟶ R.underlyingModule M :=
    P.underlyingModule.lift (R.underlyingModule.map f) h
  exact φ
